}

func (c *Checker) QualifySignatureOwners(file *ast.SourceFile) SignatureOwnerControl {
 raw:=c.getSymbolOfDeclaration(file.Statements.Nodes[0])
 typ:=c.getTypeOfSymbol(raw)
 copied:=c.cloneTypeAsModuleType(raw,typ,nil)
 original:=c.getSignaturesOfSymbol(raw)
 declarations:=c.getSignaturesOfSymbol(copied)
 keys:=len(original)==len(declarations)
 if keys {for i,sig:=range original {if sig!=declarations[i] || sig.declaration!=declarations[i].declaration {keys=false}}}
 module:=c.resolveStructuredTypeMembers(c.getTypeOfSymbol(copied))
 row:=SignatureOwnerControl{Declarations:len(copied.Declarations),RawSignatures:len(original),CopiedSignatures:len(declarations),ModuleCalls:len(module.CallSignatures()),ModuleConstructs:len(module.ConstructSignatures()),DistinctOwner:raw!=copied,SameDeclarationSignatureKeys:keys,ImplementationExcluded:len(declarations)==2&&declarations[0].declaration==raw.Declarations[0]&&declarations[1].declaration==raw.Declarations[1],RawUnredirected:c.getMergedSymbol(raw)==raw}
 extra:=file.Statements.Nodes[3]
 copied.Declarations=append(copied.Declarations,extra)
 extended:=c.getSignaturesOfSymbol(copied)
 row.ExtendedCopySignatures=len(extended)
 row.UnchangedRawSignatures=len(c.getSignaturesOfSymbol(raw))
 row.ExtendedDeclarationKey=len(extended)==3&&extended[2]==c.getSignatureFromDeclaration(extra)
 row.ExtendedModuleCalls=len(c.getSignaturesOfType(c.getTypeOfSymbol(copied),SignatureKindCall))
 return row
}
